segments.text: What was 'sweet as honey' and why?
segments.translation: 什么东西'像蜜一样甜'，为什么？

segments.text: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island,
segments.translation: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机在瓦利斯岛坠毁，

segments.text: a remote place in the South Pacific, a long way west of Samoa.
segments.translation: 那是一个位于萨摩亚以西很远的太平洋中的偏僻小岛。

segments.text: The plane wasn't too badly damaged,
but over the years the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
segments.translation: 但多年来这架飞机被人遗忘，而残骸一直无人问津。

segments.text: Then in 1989, twenty-six years after the crash, the plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
segments.translation: 后来，在1989年，即飞机坠毁26年后，在对小岛的一次空中勘查中偶然发现了这架飞机。

segments.text: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
segments.translation: 到那时候，状况良好的兰开斯特轰炸机已经很少见了，因此值得抢救。

segments.text: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
segments.translation: 法国当局把飞机打了包，分成几部分运回了法国。

segments.text: Now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.
segments.translation: 现在一群热心人正在设法修复这架飞机。

segments.text: It has four Rolls-Royce Merlin engines but the group will need to have only three of them rebuilt.
segments.translation: 它有4台劳斯莱斯梅林发动机，但这群热心人只需要修复其中3台。

segments.text: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases
segments.translation: 想一想当他们撬开包装箱

segments.text: and found that the fourth engine was sweet as honey--still in perfect condition.
segments.translation: 发现第4台发动机像蜜一样甜——依然处于完美状态时该有多高兴。

segments.text: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!
segments.translation: 一群蜜蜂把发动机当作了蜂房，发动机完好无损地保存在蜂蜡里！
